u/Kiral_ asked to see the poison recipes and what each one makes. The Rogue book has a Poisons tab now: every recipe, the level you learn it, the reagents, the poison it makes and what that poison does on your weapon. By level shows them too.

What changed since Classic. Going by the beta files, poisons hit for about a third less and carry half again as many charges. Instant Poison's first rank did 19 to 25 damage with 40 charges in Classic. Now it is 13 to 17 with 60. Wound Poison went the other way: it cuts more healing, and it stacks up to five times. Crippling Poison and Blinding Powder are the same.

One oddity: the beta's own tooltip for Instant Poison IV says 1,800 charges. That is the 30 minute duration in seconds, printed in the wrong place. The recipe's data says 130, so the book shows 130 and says why.

u/Zerza noticed Mutilate says Requires Daggers at the trainer and not on the site. The beta files leave weapon requirements out of a tooltip; the in-game readings have them. Three talents carried one: Mutilate, Holy Shield and Spearing Strike. All three say so now, on the talent and in the spellbook.

u/justrelaxok turned on the stream layout, dragged the page narrower, and the arrows between talents stayed where they were. They were only redrawn when the browser window changed size. Now they move with the trees whichever way you resize the page.
